note: Betty Control West's fabric (DR-106), cut from the one vehicle layout in scripts/fabric-shuttle.mjs -- regenerate from there, do not hand-edit. BETTY-CONTROL-WEST.metadata.json v1: ALFIE-CONTROL-WEST v2's cabin, the east cabin turned half round, the same panel mirrored, no seat.

West, the forward window: at Lawanda, the base, the bore running 51 m away west with its rails on the bed 1 m down -- this is the working cabin at the start; while BETTY-AT-KALAMONTEE the buffer 1.8 m off. East, the doorway and the car end-on, the south platform doorway off to the right at 7.6 m, and through it the platform's east end wall 18 m off: at Lawanda the south end of the sign's panel, the north edge of the escalator mouth with the flight and the last of its north balustrade (cut to fabric-lawanda.mjs escalator()'s numbers), at Kalamontee a blank wall.
